title: GenIMG diagnosis
prompt: Create a landscape 16:9 editorial technical infographic, warm cream paper #fbf7ee, charcoal typography, muted burnt orange and blue accents, large extremely legible text, clean geometry, no brand logos, no decorative robots. Title exactly 'GenIMG · diagnosis before launch'. Draw five mechanism tiles in an asymmetric bento with clear diagrams rather than metric cards. Large left tile: a folder containing a page labelled 'Your skill', an arrow labelled 'update / uninstall', an empty folder with a cross. Caption 'P1 · Skill ownership'. Upper centre tile: command ticket missing model/size, blocked doorway, caption 'P2 · Broken recipes'. Upper right: browser viewport bottom edge slicing off a Generate button under expanded prompt, caption 'P2 · Hidden action'. Lower centre: charcoal search strip with dark word Search then same strip with clearly light Search, caption 'P2 · Search contrast'. Lower right: document speech bubble labelled 'Promise' faces terminal labelled 'Reality' with unequal symbol between, caption 'P2 / P3 · Docs drift'. Small bottom label exactly 'Diagnosis, not completed fixes'. The visuals must communicate concrete mechanisms. No claims that bugs are fixed, no counts beyond the five named tiles, no other invented labels. High information clarity.

title: Skills need an owner
prompt: Landscape 16:9 editorial technical infographic. Cream background, large charcoal text, restrained orange and blue, clean flat geometric diagram and plentiful whitespace, no brand logos. Title 'P1 · Skills need an owner'. Two clearly separated horizontal lanes. Top labelled 'CURRENT': a folder labelled 'genimg/' with a document 'Your edits', arrow marked 'skills update', then crossed-out document and a replacement link labelled 'Bundled skill'. Show deletion occurring before link replacement. A small annotation 'Same name is treated as ownership'. Lower lane labelled 'PROPOSED': folder 'GenIMG skills' goes to central package box 'npx skills' then routes to three labelled agent destinations 'Claude', 'Codex', 'Cursor'. Under this lane put 'One installer · explicit scope'. At bottom a small outlined protective box with folder 'Existing skills' and label 'Migration must preserve existing files'. This is a proposed simplification, not proven safety of npx. Never label npx inherently safe; don't add shield icon. Footer 'GenIMG 0.1.0 · proposed change'. All words exact. No extra labels or fake code.

title: Recipes must work cold
prompt: Create landscape 16:9 explanatory infographic in cream and charcoal, calm precise editorial drawing, orange blocked marks, blue proposal marks plus text so no colour-only meaning. Title 'P2 · Recipes must work cold'. Two horizontal miniature journeys. Top CURRENT: a command strip '16:9 · OpenAI · 1K default' feeds into a landscape frame too small to pass a size gate, cross and word 'Rejected'. Directly beside it PROPOSED: command strip '+ -r 2K', landscape frame passes same gate, label 'Valid size'. Bottom CURRENT: command strip 'genimg "PROMPT" -n 4 -g' meets an empty model socket labelled 'No default model', cross and 'Rejected'. Directly beside it PROPOSED: command strip '+ -m gdm:nb2', socket filled with model tile, label 'Explicit model'. Both fixes show small edits to recipe tickets rather than rewriting tool machinery. Footer 'Clean config · dry-run verified · no generation needed'. No invented file trees, prices, hardware, logos, or extra commands. Ensure command text is fully accurate. Hypothetical proposed commands distinct from existing behaviour.

title: The action falls below the window
prompt: Create a landscape 16:9 diagnostic infographic, cream background charcoal outlines, large highly legible labels, restrained blue and burnt orange. Title 'P2 · The action falls below the window'. Left labelled CURRENT: schematic laptop browser frame with '1024 × 769' label. Within it vertical stack: toolbar 'Controls', rectangle 'Canvas · minimum 340px', expanded box 'Prompt'. Clearly draw browser bottom boundary as a thick dashed line, below it an outlined button labelled 'Generate' outside the visible window, arrow labelled 'Clipped'. Middle small mechanism 'Fixed canvas height + expanded prompt'. Right labelled PROPOSED: same browser frame same size, canvas somewhat shorter labelled 'Flexible canvas', prompt visible, Generate fully visible pinned within bottom boundary. Footer 'Conceptual mechanism · proposed layout, not a screenshot'. Do not imply implemented fix. Need simple human-readable engineering diagnosis, no generic laptop glamour, no invented UI controls, no logos. Shape and labels carry meaning without relying on colour.

title: Search disappears in light mode
prompt: Create 16:9 landscape editorial diagnostic infographic with cream page background, charcoal and restrained burnt orange. Title 'P2 · Search disappears in light mode'. Show two large simplified documentation headers in matched paper page frames. Left header labelled CURRENT in a clearly legible label outside the header. Header colour charcoal; within header the word Search and magnifier are almost black, intentionally very low contrast to demonstrate defect. Callout arrow points to this hidden control and says 'Dark text on dark header'. Below frame show a sun icon and label 'Light page theme'. Right frame labelled PROPOSED: same charcoal header but Search text and magnifier warm white clearly readable. Callout 'Theme the search control itself'. Between the frames a small visual of CSS parent arrow not reaching the child search component, label 'Header colour does not reach Search'. At bottom 'Search works · visibility fails'. Every explanatory label must be high contrast; only defective Search inside CURRENT is intentionally low contrast. This is a mechanism illustration, not a real screenshot, and proposal is not implemented. No extra logos or fake controls.

title: Make the docs match the tool
prompt: Landscape 16:9 precise illustrated technical diagnostic page. Cream background charcoal type, restrained burnt orange and blue, very large readable labels, four balanced mechanism panels. Title 'P2 / P3 · Make the docs match the tool'. Each panel left labelled DOCS, right labelled ACTUAL. Top left: document showing '--json on every verb' faces command ticket 'skills list --json' with a cross labelled 'Unsupported'. Top right: document shows 'Exit 2 = request sent' faces parser doorway with ticket 'Unknown flag', stopping before cloud icon, label 'Exit 2 before request'. Lower left: document shows 'Absolute output paths' faces terminal ticket '~/…/image.png', label 'Human output abbreviates home'. Lower right: document shows '#carousel-2' arrow goes to grid illustration; separate correct ticket '?view=carousel&i=2' arrow goes to single card labelled '#2'. Under panels footer 'Proposed: correct the promises; keep useful existing behaviour'. This is a factual diagnosis illustration not proof or implemented change. Draw mechanism icons with few shapes, no unrelated API vocabulary or extra facts. Preserve strings verbatim, particularly literal question mark, ampersand, and tilde.
